applies_why: The judge text rests an UNDERDETERMINED verdict on the cited text not naming whose body is the channel, which is using a single verse's silence as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: Phrase: 'a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED'; readings weighed: (1) a single verse's silence cannot support STANDS/UNDERDETERMINED, (2) a set of verses can be underdetermined by overall absence, not by one verse's silence.
why: The judge declares the point UNDERDETERMINED precisely because the cited text does not name whose body is the channel, which is the single-verse silence the rule bars as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
